description: This file defines the ConnectionLogScope class, which provides a read-only list of key-value pairs representing connection information, and implements custom string representation and enumeration for connection details.

classes.name: ConnectionLogScope
classes.description: A read-only list of key-value pairs representing connection information, providing enumerator and string representation.

methods.name: ConnectionLogScope
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the scope with a Connection object.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer that returns key-value pairs for specific connection properties based on index.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the number of items in the scope, fixed at 3.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the key-value pairs.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns a cached string representation of the connection.
